reuse.why: The new guard is one shared helper called by all six link handlers, and findOrCreateBank/syncAccount/handleSyncResponse are reused; but the takeover re-writes unlinkAccount's reset instead of reusing it, and Fintegra copies Akahu's functions.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the detach updateAccount block copies unlinkAccount's field reset.

placement.why: Link guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, download in sync.ts, URL in server-config, types in types/models, matching the tree's layering; the guard helper mixes a validation with a mutating takeover despite its 'assert' name.

scope.why: Changes serve the four steps; the two desktop-client edits are only the required Record<BankSyncProviders> entries.

maintainability.why: One guard for every provider is good, but a misnamed assert that also unlinks accounts and two more per-provider copies to keep in sync are a maintenance burden.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts resets account_id/bank/balances/sync source itself instead of going through unlinkAccount (or a local-only part extracted from it).

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicates (Fintegra link/download copied from Akahu, unlink field reset) are open copies, not reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked (app.ts) gained replaceExistingLink plus a closed-account branch and a takeover branch with side effects; all six link handlers call it.
